arguments.summary: Unauthorized access via stolen VPN credentials from user j.martinez, originating from anomalous geolocation (Russia). Forensic analysis revealed lateral movement initiated through a compromised service account (svc_unrelated_service). Attack involved phishing (T1566.001), execution via PowerShell and rundll32 (T1059.001, T1218.011), C2 beaconing (T1071.001), and host file tampering (T1565.001). The attacker pivoted to sensitive HR database assets. Immediate containment actions included blocking the source IP (10.0.5.14) on firewall (inbound/outbound) and full endpoint scan (no threats quarantined). Attempts to disable the service account and deploy hardening playbooks failed due to consensus rejection.

Attempt to deploy Ansible hardening playbook failed (consensus rejected).

arguments.rule_content:
rule Suspicious_Outlook_PowerShell_Chain {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Outlook spawning PowerShell with hidden window and encoded command"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1566.001, T1059.001"
        date = "2026-04-09"
    strings:
        $powershell_exe = "powershell.exe" nocase
        $hidden_window = "-w hidden" nocase
        $encoded_command = "-encodedcommand" nocase
        $outlook_parent = "outlook.exe" nocase
    condition:
        $outlook_parent and $powershell_exe and $hidden_window and $encoded_command
}
